name: SOLFIRE within-family boundary consensus v1
mechanism: Use newly published SOLFIRE mask geometry inside the existing UNet family; average matched UNet masks first, then equal-family pixel majority. Retain five families and all1212 instances. Generate from original1199 anchors to prevent cumulative contour drift; preserve13 recall additions exactly.

gates.existing_source_mutual_match_iou: Strictly greater than0.5 against original anchor
gates.components: Same8-connected count as current and anchor
gates.mean_family_iou: Strict improvement over current using updated family groups
gates.family_hit_count: Must not decrease relative to current at family mean IoU>0.5
gates.other_instance_pixels: Reserved by current base; remove before evaluating

if_no_change: Do not submit or relax gates
limitations: No held labels for these public prediction sources; agreement improvement is not PQ gain. Credits and source0.40 retained; full control weight reconstruction incomplete. Previous SOLFIRE recall13 additions scored no displayed gain and are not carried into this trial.
